title: work-source output
description: Answer of the extension point orch:work-source to one operation; a refusal is a reason code, not a failure of the plugin.

inspect.description: Read-only snapshot; no attempt, ownership or artifact is created.

input.description: Execution-input, additionally validated by the consumer against exec/v1.

options.description: Run options of the work as layers, general first (the plan, the phase, the item); each layer is a run-options document of the orch conductor.

source.description: Where the layer comes from, such as phase:P3 or item:P3.2.

options.description: The run options of the layer; orch checks them against its run-options contract.

reasonCode.description: Stable upper-case code of a refusal.

claim.description: Outcome of a claim: claimed (the run owns the work now), none (nothing ready) or blocked (refused).

ref.description: Reference of the claimed or refused piece of work.

title.description: Title of the piece of work.

lane.description: When the source picked the piece itself: every piece of the batch its lane names, in order (the claimed one first). Optional.

items.description: Reference of a piece of work.

depends_on.description: References of the pieces this piece depends on, when the source knows them (optional): the conductor holds a piece whose dependency in the same run ended blocked.

items.description: Reference of a piece of work.

actor_override.description: The executor the run named replaced the plan's own executor of the piece (a warning, not a refusal). Optional.

plan.description: Executor of the plan that was replaced.

run.description: Executor the piece is started for.

route.description: Minimum model route of the work.

correction.description: Minimum route of a bounded correction of recorded review findings, when the work names one (route.correction); the conductor uses it for the bounded-implementer, else the route above. Optional.

class.description: Minimum semantic model class of a correction.

effort.description: Requested reasoning effort of a correction.

session.description: Owner session recorded by the source; the run id.

options.description: Run options of the work as layers, general first (the plan, the phase, the item); each layer is a run-options document of the orch conductor.

source.description: Where the layer comes from, such as phase:P3 or item:P3.2.

options.description: The run options of the layer; orch checks them against its run-options contract.

brief.description: The brief stored as a content-addressed artifact.

input_id.description: Id of the brief, ending with @ and the first digest characters.

reused.description: Whether the store already held this brief.

artifact_id.description: Name of the brief artifact, derived from the reference and the digest.

artifacts_dir.description: Repository-relative folder where a run keeps the committed artifacts of the piece of work (stage-report, review verdict, check evidence).

output_write_dirs.description: Canonical absolute directories for declared outputs of this item outside the checkout.

register.description: Outcome of a registration and the state of its acceptance gate.

outcome.description: recorded, no-op for a repeat, or refused.

gate.description: Evidence gate: pass, missing or red evidence, stale owner, or none (no gate applied).

checks.description: Exit proven by the evidence of each acceptance check; null when missing.

evidence.description: Where the source keeps the evidence of the work for good, by check id, when not where the request named it (a plan in a workspace keeps it with the plan). Optional.

^V[0-9]+$.description: Path of the kept evidence, as the source refers to it.

commit.description: Outcome of a commit: committed, no-op (nothing left to commit, or the attempt already committed) or refused.

attempt.description: Attempt whose commit request produced this answer.

repo.description: Repository of sha: the project checkout or, when only plan files changed, the plan workspace. Given by a source whose plans live outside the checkout.

workspace_sha.description: Local commit of the plan files in the plan workspace, null when there is none.

workspace_commit.description: Outcome of the plan-file commit in the plan workspace; a failure does not undo the commit of sha.

error.description: Code and message of the failure.

release.description: Outcome of a release: released (the claim is off the run), no-op (the run does not hold the piece) or refused.

note.description: Outcome of a note: recorded, no-op (the same note is already there) or refused.

research.description: Outcome of saving a research result: recorded, no-op (the same result is already saved) or refused.

path.description: Repository-relative path of the saved result.

decision.description: Outcome of recording a decision: recorded, no-op (the decision of this question is already there), refused or unsupported (the source does not serve the operation).

decision_id.description: Id of the decision in the source, such as D12.

readiness.description: Readiness of the detailed groups of a collection and its next step: ok with phases and next, or refused with a reason code (READINESS_UNSUPPORTED: the source does not serve the operation).

phases.description: Every detailed group of the collection, in its order, with the state of its readiness certificate.

id.description: Id of the group, such as P3.

status.description: missing (no certificate), ready, ready_with_advisories, not_ready or stale (the group or the policy changed since the certificate).

digest.description: Current semantic digest of the group.

next.description: The first lane the source would give work for: run-items with its items, or another kind (waiting, audit-phase, design-phase, terminal, ...) with a message.

kind.description: Kind of the next step, such as run-items, waiting or audit-phase.

items.description: References of the pieces of a run-items lane, in order; empty for another kind.
Reference of a piece of work.

phase.description: Group of the step, when it has one.

message.description: Why there is no lane to run, for a kind other than run-items.
